scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.rmSync('backend/public',{recursive:true,force:true}); fs.cpSync('frontend/dist','backend/public',{recursive:true});" && npm --prefix backend run build
